content.instructions: Use “am” with days and parts of the day (“am Montag, am Abend, am Wochenende”), “im” with seasons and months (“im Sommer, im Mai”), and “jeden” for "every" (“jeden Tag, jeden Sonntag”). Frequency words sit after the verb: “Ich gehe oft ins Kino.”
